steps: Conscious: 15–20 g fast-acting oral carbohydrate, repeat in 15 min if still low.
Impaired/NBM: IV glucose (e.g. 100 mL 20%) or IM glucagon if no IV access.
Follow with longer-acting carbohydrate once recovered.
Sulfonylurea/long-acting insulin overdose: prolonged monitoring ± octreotide; admit.
Review drugs/diabetes regimen; address recurrent causes.

confirm: Whipple's triad: low plasma glucose with autonomic/neuroglycopenic symptoms relieved by glucose. Identify cause (insulin/sulfonylurea, sepsis, etc.).
